source: CMS HEP Tutorial ntuple, 2011 data, 7 TeV, HLT_IsoMu24

samples.title: Z → μμ
samples.label: dimuon
samples.about: Two muons of opposite charge. Their invariant mass peaks at the Z boson, 91 GeV.

samples.title: W → μν
samples.label: single muon
samples.about: One isolated muon and missing E_T from the neutrino. Their transverse mass has its edge at the W mass, 80 GeV.

samples.title: tt̄ → μ + jets
samples.label: top pair
samples.about: An isolated muon, four or more jets and a b-tag. The three-jet mass M3 peaks near the top quark, 173 GeV.
